games.name: Build A Mountain
games.description:
⛰️ Carry blocks and build the world's most famous mountains together with your whole server! Start with Mount Everest, then Machu Picchu, Mount Fuji and more.

How to play:
🧱 Collect blocks at the quarry and stack them on your head.
🏔️ Place them layer by layer and build the mountain with everyone.
💪 Train Strength and Speed at the gym to carry more and move faster.
🗺️ Build 7 wonders: Mount Everest, Machu Picchu, Pixel Peak, Mount Fuji, the Matterhorn, Kilimanjaro and the Pyramids of Giza.
🔍 Find 34 hidden secrets inside the mountains.
🎁 Daily rewards, quests, gifts, events and Ascend to grow even stronger!

🎮 Play on PC, mobile, tablet and console.
games.creator: Rocket Meteor

games.name: Press The Button
games.description:
🔴 PRESS THE BUTTON! 🔴
It's a big red button. What happens if you press it? There's only one way to find out...

Press the button to fill the bar and make chests drop onto the board. Open them to find items, earn gold and unlock new things as you go!

✨ FEATURES
• Thousands of clicks, lots of chests and a whole collection of items to discover
• Upgrades to earn more gold, faster
• A gacha machine, lucky dice, a prize wheel and golden items
• Surprises like black holes and a mysterious cat
• Rebirth to earn Rewind Coins and grow your skill tree
• An encyclopedia with every item and all your stats
• Achievements and badges to collect
• PimpoliDev, your friendly guide, teaches you step by step
• Customize your button and your floor with the Supporter Pack

📱💻🎮 Play on phone, tablet, PC and console

How far can you get... just by pressing a button?

Made by Rocket Meteor

games.name: [🎃] Troll Avalanche 😈
games.description:
🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT! Grab candy on the stairs to unlock the PUMPKIN GLOVE and throw pumpkins from the top!

🚗💥 Cars, toilets, barrels, beds and even HOUSES crash down a 1,000 m staircase. Can you reach the top?

👍 LIKE + JOIN THE GROUP FOR FREE CASH! 👍

🏃 Run, dodge and hide behind the blocks. Don't get flattened!
🏆 Reach the top to win Cash, then grab FREE boxes, cars, BOMBS and mystery boxes to throw at everyone below!
😈 Troll your friends: freeze, blind, blow up or push them!
🧤 Unlock gloves, coils, jetpacks and magic carpets. Rebirth to get even stronger!
🎁 Play 5, 10, 20 and 30 minutes for FREE shields, the Gold Glove, the God Coil and the Jet Pack!
🔁 New round every 10 minutes.

😎 Survive. Troll. Repeat.
